associations.rationale: The displayed type exposes HasAbelianSeries only as an opaque proposition on groups, so it does not directly state the finite normal-series and abelian-quotient characterization.
The type derives normality of one step from a commutator containment, a prerequisite for the claimed normal series rather than the full solvability characterization.
The type equates commutativity of one successive quotient with a commutator containment, supporting the abelian-quotient condition but not the finite series or derived-series termination claim.

The type identifies the opaque HasAbelianSeries predicate with the opaque IsSolvable predicate; without either definition displayed, it does not directly state the entire normal-series and derived-series characterization.
